I am a postdoctoral researcher at Argonne National Laboratory working on scientific machine learning — neural operators, diffusion models, and climate and atmospheric modeling.

This blog has two threads. One is a build log for an AI that plays city-building and business simulation games, documented in public, failures included. The other is research notes from the lab: methods, papers, and things I wish someone had written down.

New posts appear when there is something worth saying, roughly once a week.
